name: Boreal & Fennoscandian Scots Pine Allometry Dataset
source: Fennoscandian Forestry Consortium & Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU)

publication_reference.citation: Zianis, D., et al. (2005). Biomass and stem volume equations for tree species in Europe. Silva Fennica Monographs, 4, 1-63.

geographic_scope.description: Fennoscandia, Baltic States, and Boreal Eurasia

collection_methodology: Destructive tree felling during winter dormant season. Direct weighing of dry stem wood, branches, needles, and stump.

dbh_cm.name: Diameter at Breast Height
dbh_cm.definition: Measured at 1.30 m height above ground level.

height_m.name: Total Tree Height
height_m.definition: Vertical distance from base to apical bud.

age_years.name: Stand Age
age_years.definition: Time elapsed since plantation establishment or natural regeneration cohort inception.

wood_density_g_cm3.name: Basic Wood Density
wood_density_g_cm3.definition: Oven-dry mass divided by fresh green xylem volume.

preprocessing_information.outlier_handling: Residual standard error filtering on preliminary log-linear fits.
preprocessing_information.missing_values: Imputation prohibited for target dry biomass.
preprocessing_information.transformations: Natural logarithm transformation with standard error correction factor.
